H01-01: Inspection of required attributes and hidden status via aria-hidden or CSS.
Pass: No required fields are hidden without visual cues, or they belong to custom UI components.
Fail: Required fields are hidden (aria/CSS) or lack visual required indicators.
1. Select input, textarea, select with the required attribute (ignore type="hidden").
2. Check if hidden by aria-hidden="true" or CSS (display:none / visibility:hidden).
3. Check for * or required text in <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, placeholder, or class.
4. Exempt custom UI widgets (e.g., tabindex="-1", role="combobox", role="switch").
- The required field must be made visible and accessible by removing aria-hidden="true".
- The required field must be made visible by removing display: none or visibility: hidden.
If visible but lacks a required indicator:
- Add a * or (required) indicator to the field’s <label> to clearly mark it.
